object.prompt: A magical collectible runestone using the selected reference object as its exact shape, stone material, proportions and pixel-art style. Replace the heart with a clearly recognizable sword symbol carved into the center. The symbol glows with intense amber-orange magical energy. Add subtle orange magical particles suggesting strength and destructive power. Preserve the same stone silhouette, outlines, texture and level of detail as the reference. Front-facing side-scroller game object, centered, readable at 64x64 pixels, transparent background. No characters, scenery, text, blur or anti-aliasing.
